C1818.title: Venezuelan President Maduro Drone Assassination Incident
C1818.summary: On August 4, 2018, while Venezuelan President Maduro addressed the National Guard outdoors on Bolivar Avenue in Caracas, two DJI M600 drones carrying explosives detonated over the formation. The first air-burst over the National Guard formation injured 7-8 soldiers; the second hit an apartment building two blocks from the podium, injuring one civilian. Maduro was unharmed under bodyguards' bulletproof shields. The government classified it as an assassination attempt on the president — the first public drone assassination of a head of state.
